source.title: Frieren - The Legendary Mage
source.name: Frieren
source.description: A thousand-year-old elven Mage. While she struggles to read human emotions, her curiosity for magic knows no bounds.

skills.name: Zoltraak

description.raw: Frieren moves to the rearmost position that maximizes the number of enemies her Ultimate can hit. The Ultimate strikes enemies in a 3-tile rectangular area for 3s, dealing 220% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage per second and 1400% (ATK-based) + 180% (SP-based) true damage evenly split among all enemies hit.
active: Frieren moves to the rearmost position that maximizes the number of enemies her Ultimate can hit.

The Ultimate strikes enemies in a 3-tile rectangular area for 3s, dealing 220% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage per second and 1400% (ATK-based) + 180% (SP-based) true damage evenly split among all enemies hit.

text: Increases damage per second to 240% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based), and the extra true damage to 1500% (ATK-based) + 180% (SP-based).
Increases damage per second to 260% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based), and the extra true damage to 1600% (ATK-based) + 180% (SP-based).
Increases damage per second to 280% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based), and the extra true damage to 1700% (ATK-based) + 180% (SP-based).
Increases damage per second to 300% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based), and the extra true damage to 1800% (ATK-based) + 180% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Frieren deals heavy damage to enemies in a 3-tile rectangular area.

skills.name: Lightning: Judradjim

description.raw: When a battle starts, Frieren conceals her magic, making enemies less likely to target her. 15s into the battle, she amplifies her magic power, increasing her damage dealt by 60%, replacing her normal attack with Lightning: Judradjim, and no longer being a low-priority target for enemies. Lightning: Judradjim strikes an enemy 3 times, each hit dealing 220% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage, and the final hit stuns the target for 0.5s. After fighting alongside Himmel for 5s, Frieren immediately amplifies her magic power, ignoring the time restriction, and gains a permanent ATK bonus equal to 30% of Himmel's initial ATK.
active: When a battle starts, Frieren conceals her magic, making enemies less likely to target her.

Increases Lightning: Judradjim's damage per hit to 240% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based).
Increases Lightning: Judradjim's damage per hit to 250% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: When a battle starts, Frieren conceals her magic. After a short time, she amplifies her magic power, increasing her damage and replacing her normal attack with Lightning: Judradjim, which deals higher damage and can stun enemies.

skills.name: Hellfire: Vollzanbel

description.raw: Frieren casts Hellfire: Vollzanbel, dealing 300% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to the target and adjacent enemies and burning the area for 5s. Enemies in the burning area lose 35% (ATK-based) HP every 0.5s, and their Vitality is reduced by 20+ 5 (SP-based). After Frieren amplifies her magic power, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 50%.

skills.name: Defensive Spell

description.raw: When a battle starts, Frieren casts defensive magic on herself and the frontmost ally. When either takes damage exceeding 10% of their initial max HP, the excess damage is reduced by 75%.

text: The excess damage is reduced by 80%.
While the frontmost ally remains alive, Frieren increases her Haste by 35.
The excess damage is reduced by 85%.

skills.description_lite: Frieren reduces damage taken by herself and the frontmost ally.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: 5s after Frieren amplifies her magic power, she knocks the enemy with the most cumulative damage dealt into the air and hurls them toward the edge of the battlefield, dealing 800% (ATK-based) damage and knocking them down for 2s.
